description: Defines the AdaptiveAudioDecoder class for handling adaptive audio decoding, including initialization, decoding, resetting, and output management within a media playback system.

classes.name: AdaptiveAudioDecoder
classes.description: A class that manages adaptive audio decoding, including initialization, decoding, output handling, and reset functionalities, tailored for media streaming scenarios.

methods.name: AdaptiveAudioDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adaptive audio decoder with stream info, DRM system, decoder creator, and optional output format adjustment callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output and error callbacks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of the input stream.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data and outputs the sample rate.

methods.name: TeardownAudioDecoder
methods.description: Cleans up and releases the audio decoder resources.
